analyst.summary: Honasa Consumer (Mamaearth) is India's leading digital-first beauty and personal care company, which went through a genuine profit decline in the year after its 2023 IPO as customer-acquisition costs and competition pressured margins, before recovering sharply in the most recent year through cost discipline and brand-portfolio focus. Revenue growth remains healthy in the mid-to-high-teens, but the trailing TTM profit-growth figure is inflated by recovering off a depressed prior-year base and should not be read as a repeatable rate. We rate this a Hold.
